content.short: Apply Torque is a Web3 wallet tool.
content.description: Apply Torque delivers a DeFi toolkit for robust vesting and token distribution workflows. It enables creating and managing vesting for any token, supports multi-sender transfers, and offers real-time dashboards to monitor activity. Project owners can set up linear vesting schedules, create token lockers, and perform multisend operations to multiple recipients with CSV import, all in a single streamlined interface.
